name: Sosa Sherb | 1.5G Eclair Handcraft
description:
Sosa Sherb | 1.5G Éclair Handcraft | HYMAN | REC 
The new fan favorite, elevated. Each Éclair is handcrafted with 1g of premium flower and infused with 0.5g of cold-cured, single-source rosin. Finished with our signature glass tip and H2O brushed for a perfect seal and an even burn — all for the perfect HY. 
GET BAKED TWICE 💨 
Strain Type: Hybrid 
Mood: Peaceful & Relaxed 
Flavor & Aroma: Berry, Creamy
